# Claire's Itchy Feet

> > A family travel blog specializing in Greek island adventures, luxury accommodations, and active travel experiences across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Claire's Itchy Feet focuses on practical travel planning with detailed guides to Greece (Santorini, Kefalonia, Zakynthos, Skopelos), Italy, and global destinations. The site emphasizes family-friendly itineraries, hotel recommendations, and active exploration from hiking to culinary experiences.

## Key Topics

- Greece island hopping
- Santorini travel
- Ionian Islands
- Family travel planning
- Greek islands guides
- Italy vacation planning
- Hotel recommendations
- Travel gear reviews
- Business class flights
- Bali wellness retreats
- Digital nomad insurance
- Cruise planning
- Active travel adventures
- Luxury villas
- Greek culinary experiences

## Greece Travel Guides

- [3 Weeks Island Hopping in Greece Itinerary](https://clairesitchyfeet.com/greek-island-hopping-itinerary): 3-week Greece island hopping itinerary through Cyclades and Ionian islands

- [Exploring Kefalonia's Majestic Mountains on Foot](https://clairesitchyfeet.com/exploring-kefalonias-majestic-mountains-on-foot): Kefalonia mountain hiking trails and family adventure guide for Greece
- [Discover Zakynthos' Top Beaches](https://clairesitchyfeet.com/discover-zakynthos-top-beaches): Zakynthos beach guide featuring Navagio Shipwreck Beach and family spots
- [Exploring Skopelos in Peak Season](https://clairesitchyfeet.com/exploring-skopelos-in-peak-season): Skopelos summer travel guide for peak season Greek island family trips
- [Savour the Flavours of Oia: A Culinary Journey](https://clairesitchyfeet.com/savour-the-flavours-of-oia-a-culinary-journey): Oia Santorini food tours, restaurants, and Greek culinary experiences
